items.title: Simultaneous multi-bind: stdio + UDS + streamable HTTP
items.evidence: resolveTransports() returns array from opts.transports; connectStdio/connectUds/connectStreamableHttp all bind simultaneously. 21 tests in transport.spec.ts cover multi-bind lifecycle, mode resolution, and type-level ToolDispatch (tr-1-describe). build + lint green.

items.title: Bind/auth policy: loopback default, bearer for non-loopback, refuse tokenless
items.evidence: validateBindAuth() refuses 0.0.0.0 without token (throws); authMiddleware() returns 401 on missing/wrong/malformed token, 200 on correct token. 12 auth-specific tests in transport.spec.ts: 6 validateBindAuth + 5 authMiddleware + negative control (removing guard makes tokenless pass). isLoopback() correctly classifies 127.0.0.1/::1/localhost vs 0.0.0.0/10.x/192.168.x. resolveBindHost defaults to 127.0.0.1.

items.title: http_port from config truth in listener AND host-config generation
items.evidence: declarativeInstall() now reads http_port + bind_address from descriptor.resolvedConfig (the cascade-resolved config), not the literal 3000. Claude-format fallback builds URL from resolved port/host with localhost normalization for loopback addresses. OpenCode mcpConfig.value() accepts optional port+bindAddress params, passed through by the caller. http_port added to memory-server config_schema with x-sox-default:3000, consumed by both the transport listener and host-config gen. 5 new tests in opencode.spec.ts cover port parameter (TR-3), bindAddress (TR-4), and localhost normalization for 127.0.0.1/::1. host-registry 112/112, install-engine 156/156, mcp-runtime 32/32 all green.

items.title: URL-only host configs for claude + opencode
items.evidence: McpConfig.value() on both opencode.ts (mcpConfig) and install.ts (Claude fallback) generates remote URLs from port + bind_address parameters. No hardcoded 3000 left in OpenCode host config generation — the value flows from config cascade via resolvedConfig.http_port. install.ts Claude fallback removes 'http://localhost:3000/' + profile pattern entirely; now builds 'http://<displayHost>:<port>/mcp' from resolvedConfig. localhost normalization for 127.0.0.1/::1 improves host config portability. Config schema (extension.json) defines http_port with x-sox-default:3000 as the single source of truth.
